title: Mass Effect
subtitle: the Shepard trilogy and its DLC, then Andromeda
blurb: The trilogy, 7 story DLC and Andromeda — about 101 hours of story, 66 of it the trilogy itself.
notes: The trilogy is a single story that reads your choices forward — play it in order, carry the save. Legendary Edition (2021) is all three remastered with the DLC already inside, and it is the way in; whichever edition you play, tick the same rows.

Only the major story add-ons HowLongToBeat tracks separately got rows; inside Legendary they are simply missions you pass on the way. The short companion packs — Kasumi, Zaeed, From Ashes — are not split out. And it is Bring Down the Sky, not Bringing — the asteroid is the thing being brought.
Arrival is the bridge into 3, so it goes last in 2; Citadel is the series' goodbye and lands hardest just before 3's finale. The rows sit in release order regardless.
A different galaxy, a different crew, no Shepard — the trilogy is complete without it, and it is marked optional for that reason, not because it is short.
HowLongToBeat main-story figures — no side quests, no scanning planets. A completionist trilogy run is roughly double.
Game and DLC list from Wikipedia's Mass Effect articles; hours from HowLongToBeat main-story figures, matched by name and year.
